scope: Theorem 1.2 (Original-data equality) of the manuscript “The nonmaximal anti-de Sitter Penrose Inequality and original-data rigidity” (preprints/The-nonmaximal-anti-de-Sitter-Penrose-Inequality-and-original-data-rigidity-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9e2b9ba2768918dc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume in addition the connected horizon hypotheses of Definition 2.6. Equality in Equation 1.1 holds if and only if the original pair (g, K) is realized by a smooth proper spacelike embedding of Ω, with boundary, into the smooth maximally extended Schwarzschild–anti-de Sitter spacetime of parameter exactly M = mAH(g). Its interior lies in one black-hole exterior; its boundary maps diffeomorphically onto a full smooth spacelike cross-section of that exterior’s future event horizon, with the bifurcation sphere also allowed; and its unique end reaches that exterior’s conformal infinity. The embedding induces both g and K with the future-normal convention of Equation 2.5.
